name: Tarbert (Loch Fyne)
method: tidetimes.org.uk Tarbert (Loch Fyne) vs its own Millport (UKHO-derived), applied to our gauge-fitted Millport: median time difference, least-squares height fit
note: East Loch Tarbert. HW and LW heights each = offset + scale * Millport: springs reach ~0.2 m higher. Kayak-grade, not for navigation.
calibrated_from: tidetimes.org.uk Tarbert vs Millport, 2025-10-01 to 2026-11-25 (every 3 day(s), 541 events) via tools/calibrate-shift.ts
